title: Inspector Vulnerability and Finding Trends

controlTest.negativeScenario: Replay benign `aws:inspector` traffic without `severity="CRITICAL" OR severity="HIGH"`. Confirm UC-4.1.44 returns zero rows and the alert does not fire.

detailedImplementation:
Prerequisites
• Splunk Enterprise or Splunk Cloud with search access to `index=aws`.
• Install and configure `Splunk_TA_aws` with the modular input for `aws:inspector`.
• Prerequisite crawl UC(s): UC-4.1.78.
• Confirm field extractions in `props.conf` for `userIdentity.arn` and related actor fields.

Step 1 — Configure data collection
Configure Inspector to send findings to EventBridge or SNS; ingest in Splunk. Alert on new CRITICAL findings. Dashboard open findings by severity and age. Correlate with patch compliance (SSM).
Validate ingest before alerting:
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:inspector" | stats count by sourcetype
```

Step 2 — Create the search and alert
```spl
index=aws sourcetype="aws:inspector" severity="CRITICAL" OR severity="HIGH"
| table _time userIdentity.arn eventName sourceIPAddress
| eval uc_marker="UC-4.1.44_inspector_vulnerability_44"
| sort -_time
```

Understanding this SPL
Scopes `aws:inspector` in `index=aws` to detect inspector vulnerability and finding trends. Tune thresholds to your change cadence; exclude break-glass principals and sandbox accounts via a lookup.

Step 3 — Validate
Compare to the provider cloud console audit view for the same 24-hour window. Confirm row counts and `userIdentity.arn` values match the vendor console. Run `| fieldsummary` on a 1-hour sample to verify extractions.

Step 4 — Operationalize and troubleshoot
Save as `4_1_44_alert` with severity aligned to `high` criticality. Dashboard: Table (severity, type, count), Bar chart by severity, Trend line (findings over time)..
Failure modes: (1) no events — verify modular input/API credentials and index routing; (2) empty actor fields — upgrade `Splunk_TA_aws` and review alias mappings; (3) API throttling — reduce poll frequency or enable queue buffering; (4) alert fatigue — tune thresholds and document exclusions in knownFalsePositives.
grandmaExplanation: We watch cloud logs for signs of inspector vulnerability and finding trends so your team catches problems in your online services before customers or auditors do.
